title: Significant Others: A Sneak Peek at the Woman Behind Benedict Arnold’s Betrayal

sentences.en: Hey, beautiful nerds.
sentences.zh: 嘿，各位美丽的极客们。

sentences.en: It's Roman Mars here to tell you about a podcast that you might enjoy
sentences.zh: 我是罗曼·马尔斯，来向大家推荐一个你可能会喜欢的播客，

sentences.en: if you appreciate overlooked details like we discuss here at 99% Invisible.
sentences.zh: 如果你也像我们在《99%隐形》节目里一样，欣赏那些被忽视的细节。

sentences.en: In this case,
sentences.zh: 在这种情况下，

sentences.en: the overlooked details are actually humans.
sentences.zh: 被忽视的细节其实就是人类。

sentences.en: The podcast is called Significant Others,
sentences.zh: 这个播客名叫《另一半》（Significant Others），

sentences.en: and it tells stories of folks just beyond the spotlight of history.
sentences.zh: 它讲述了那些处于历史聚光灯边缘的人物的故事。

sentences.en: Each episode tells the
sentences.zh: 每一集都讲述了一个

sentences.en: story of a talented, difficult, and little-known individual who altered the destiny of their
sentences.zh: 才华横溢、性格难搞且鲜为人知的个人的故事，正是这个人改变了他们

sentences.en: better-known partner, child, sibling, friend, and impacted the world that they left behind.
sentences.zh: 更知名的伴侣、孩子、兄弟姐妹、朋友的命运，并影响了他们所留下的世界。

sentences.en: The first episode covers a name I bet you haven't heard before, Peggy Shippen,
sentences.zh: 第一集的主角是一个我敢打赌你以前没听过的名字——佩吉·希彭，

sentences.en: but I am sure you've heard of her husband, Benedict Arnold.
sentences.zh: 但我确信你一定听过她的丈夫，贝内迪克特·阿诺德。

sentences.en: Here's a snippet of the episode that
sentences.zh: 以下是该集的一个片段，

sentences.en: explores how Benedict Arnold may have never turned on his country and made his own name
sentences.zh: 探讨了如果不是因为佩吉，贝内迪克特·阿诺德可能永远不会背叛祖国，

sentences.en: synonymous with treason, were it not for Peggy.
sentences.zh: 并让自己的名字成为叛国的代名词。

sentences.en: The scene in Philadelphia when Arnold arrived was bleak.
sentences.zh: 阿诺德抵达时，费城的景象十分惨淡。

sentences.en: Citizens were starving.
sentences.zh: 市民们在挨饿。

sentences.en: Whole neighborhoods
sentences.zh: 整片整片的街区

sentences.en: were burned.
sentences.zh: 被烧毁。

sentences.en: Horses lay dead in their traces.
sentences.zh: 马匹倒毙在挽具中。

sentences.en: Churches were stripped of their pews and pulpits,
sentences.zh: 教堂的长椅和讲道台被洗劫一空，

sentences.en: and gravestones had been overturned.
sentences.zh: 墓碑也被推翻了。

sentences.en: Independence Hall was bare, and Washington Square was filled with
sentences.zh: 独立厅空空如也，华盛顿广场上挤满了

sentences.en: 2,000 American corpses.
sentences.zh: 2000具美国人的尸体。

sentences.en: The only part of town that appeared untouched by the British Army's
sentences.zh: 城里唯一看起来没有受到英军占领影响的地方，

sentences.en: occupation was the one square mile of homes and shops where the wealthy folk lived.
sentences.zh: 就是富人们居住的那一平方英里的住宅和商店区。

sentences.en: In other words,
sentences.zh: 换句话说，

sentences.en: Peggy Shippen's neighborhood.
sentences.zh: 也就是佩吉·希彭的街区。

sentences.en: Benedict Arnold was brave, brilliant, and had a tin ear for PR.
sentences.zh: 贝内迪克特·阿诺德勇敢、才华横溢，但对公关却毫无敏锐度。

sentences.en: He was constantly doing things that rubbed people the wrong way, like the time he accused his
sentences.zh: 他总是做一些惹人生厌的事情，比如有一次他指控他的

sentences.en: commanding officer of demoting him out of jealousy.
sentences.zh: 指挥官出于嫉妒将他降职。

sentences.en: In this charged moment when political ideology was
sentences.zh: 在这个政治意识形态正在

sentences.en: getting people killed, and even trying to stay out of the fight could get you into trouble,
sentences.zh: 让人送命、甚至连试图置身事外都会惹祸上身的紧张时刻，

sentences.en: he didn't worry about public opinion.
sentences.zh: 他却根本不担心公众舆论。

sentences.en: He moved right into the same mansion the British general had just
sentences.zh: 他直接搬进了英国将军刚

sentences.en: vacated, and picked up where Howe and his officers had left off, with the socializing and the theater going,
sentences.zh: 刚腾出来的那座豪宅，接着豪乌和他的军官们停下的地方继续享乐，进行社交、看戏，

sentences.en: and the special favors for loyalist friends.
sentences.zh: 并为保皇党朋友提供特殊照顾。

sentences.en: He even had the same taste in women.
sentences.zh: 他甚至对女性有着同样的品味。

sentences.en: It would be ideal to tell the story of Arnold's courtship of Peggy Shippen in her voice, but unfortunately
sentences.zh: 用佩吉自己的声音来讲述阿诺德追求她的故事本应是理想的，但遗憾的是

sentences.en: that cannot be done.
sentences.zh: 这无法做到。

sentences.en: Nearly all of her letters have since been destroyed, either by herself or her family,
sentences.zh: 她几乎所有的信件后来都被销毁了，要么是她自己销毁的，要么是她的家人销毁的，

sentences.en: except for any that might frame her as a patriot.
sentences.zh: 只留下那些可能会把她塑造成爱国者的信件。

sentences.en: We do know that they first met when Peggy was 14
sentences.zh: 我们确实知道，他们初次见面时，佩吉14岁，

sentences.en: and the 33-year-old Arnold was on his way through town.
sentences.zh: 而33岁的阿诺德正途经此地。

sentences.en: He didn't creep on her then, but he was likely
sentences.zh: 他当时并没有对她起什么龌龊心思，但他很可能

sentences.en: impressed, as most everyone was, by not only her beauty and her charm, but her intellect, education,
sentences.zh: 和大多数人一样，不仅对她的美貌和魅力印象深刻，而且对她的才智、教育

sentences.en: and knowledge of current political events.
sentences.zh: 以及对当前政治事件的了解赞叹不已。

sentences.en: By the time he came back in 1778, she was 18, and so, fair game.
sentences.zh: 当他在1778年回来时，她已经18岁了，因此，大好机会来了。

sentences.en: Peggy, in that same moment, was like a freshly crowned homecoming queen whose entire football team
sentences.zh: 此时此刻的佩吉，就像是一位刚刚加冕的返校节王后，而她整个橄榄球队

sentences.en: has just up and left town.
sentences.zh: 却刚刚双双离开了小镇。

sentences.en: All the guys who had been fawning over her were gone.
sentences.zh: 所有曾经对她阿谀奉承的家伙都不见了。

sentences.en: The vibe was rough,
sentences.zh: 气氛十分尴尬，

sentences.en: and what could she possibly have had to look forward to?
sentences.zh: 她还能有什么指望呢？

sentences.en: But here comes the commanding, tragically
sentences.zh: 但就在这时，那位威严、遭遇悲惨丧偶的

sentences.en: widowed coach of the home team, still limping from the wound he heroically suffered while defending his
sentences.zh: 主队教练出现了，他因为在保卫祖国时

sentences.en: country.
sentences.zh: 英勇负伤而至今一瘸一拐。

sentences.en: And it turns out he hosts parties that are just as good as the other guys.
sentences.zh: 事实证明，他举办的派对和那些家伙办得一样好。

sentences.en: And even though he
sentences.zh: 而且尽管他

sentences.en: can't dance, he pays a lot of attention to her on the sidelines.
sentences.zh: 不会跳舞，但在场边时他非常关注她。

sentences.en: Plus, he's being nice to her
sentences.zh: 另外，他对她

sentences.en: friends' families, even though they were technically in league with the other side.
sentences.zh: 朋友的家人也很好，尽管他们从技术层面上讲是站在另一边的。

sentences.en: So, yeah, Peggy was just
sentences.zh: 所以，好吧，佩吉对于被这个政权

sentences.en: as happy to be adored by this regime as she had been by the last one.
sentences.zh: 崇拜，和之前被上一个政权崇拜一样感到高兴。

sentences.en: Now, this characterization
sentences.zh: 现在，这种性格刻画

sentences.en: likely does not capture Peggy as she really was.
sentences.zh: 可能并没有真正捕捉到真实的佩吉。

sentences.en: In fact, according to one friend, there was,
sentences.zh: 事实上，据一位朋友说，

sentences.en: quote, nothing of frivolity either in her dress, demeanor, or conduct, end quote.
sentences.zh: 引用原话：“无论是在着装、风度还是行为上，都没有一丝轻浮。”引文结束。

sentences.en: She had a
sentences.zh: 她对

sentences.en: demonstrable interest in and facility for both politics and business.
sentences.zh: 政治和商业表现出明显的兴趣和天赋。

sentences.en: And her father, who was so bookish
sentences.zh: 她的父亲是个书呆子，

sentences.en: that he spent his entire dowry on a personal library, let her read everything.
sentences.zh: 甚至把全部嫁妆都花在了购买个人藏书上，他允许她阅读一切书籍。

sentences.en: Years later, she said she had
sentences.zh: 多年后，她说自己

sentences.en: had the most useful and best education that America, at that time, afforded.
sentences.zh: 接受了当时美国所能提供的最有用、最好的教育。

sentences.en: But still, she was a teenage
sentences.zh: 但即便如此，她也还是个十几岁的

sentences.en: girl, so isn't it possible some of this rings a little bit true?
sentences.zh: 女孩，所以其中有些话听起来是不是也有那么一点真实呢？

sentences.en: Within a few months of meeting Peggy
sentences.zh: 在认识佩吉·希彭

sentences.en: Shippen, the 37-year-old Arnold had pledged himself to her.
sentences.zh: 几个月后，37岁的阿诺德便向她表白了心迹。

sentences.en: At first, she friend-zoned him.
sentences.zh: 起初，她发了好人卡给他。

sentences.en: Maybe she
sentences.zh: 也许她

sentences.en: learned by watching her father how to keep her options open by refusing to commit.
sentences.zh: 通过观察父亲，学会了如何通过拒绝承诺来为自己保留选择的余地。

sentences.en: But Arnold found a way
sentences.zh: 但阿诺德找到了一个办法，

sentences.en: to spin her offer of friendship and esteem into something more significant.
sentences.zh: 把她给予的友谊和敬意扭曲成了更有分量的东西。

sentences.en: Friendship and esteem,
sentences.zh: 友谊与敬意，

sentences.en: you acknowledge.
sentences.zh: 你如是承认。

sentences.en: Dear Peggy, suffer that heavenly bosom, which cannot know itself the cause of pain
sentences.zh: 亲爱的佩吉，如果那颗若不能自身感同身受就无法察觉痛苦的崇高心灵，

sentences.en: without a sympathetic pang, to expand with a sensation more soft or tender than friendship.
sentences.zh: 能够怀揣一种比友谊更轻柔、更温存的情感而悸动，请允许它吧。

sentences.en: Friendship and esteem, founded on the merit of the object, is the most certain basis to build a
sentences.zh: 基于对象之美德的友谊与敬意，是构建

sentences.en: lasting happiness upon.
sentences.zh: 持久幸福的最可靠基础。

sentences.en: And when there is a tender and ardent passion on one side, and friendship and
sentences.zh: 而当一方怀有温柔而炽热的激情，另一方心存

sentences.en: esteem on the other, the heart, unlike yours, must be callous to every tender sentiment if the taper of love
sentences.zh: 友谊与敬意时，如果爱情的烛火没有在火焰中点燃，

sentences.en: is not lighted up at the flame.
sentences.zh: 那么这颗心必定会像你的心一样，对任何温柔的情感都冷酷麻木。

sentences.en: Whatever my fate may be, my most ardent wish is for your happiness.
sentences.zh: 无论我的命运如何，我最炽热的愿望就是祝你幸福。

sentences.en: And my latest breath will be to implore the blessing of heaven on the idle and only wish of my soul.
sentences.zh: 我最后的一口气也将用来祈求上天的祝福，降临于我灵魂中这个闲适却唯一的愿望。

sentences.en: Parts of this letter were cribbed almost verbatim from one he had written months earlier to Boston
sentences.zh: 这封信的部分内容几乎是一字不差地抄袭自他几个月前写给波士顿

sentences.en: Betsy.
sentences.zh: 贝茜的信。

sentences.en: Apparently, he kept a copy of every letter he wrote, perhaps to save himself from having to
sentences.zh: 显然，他保留了自己写过的每一封信的副本，也许是为了省去

sentences.en: reinvent such wheels.
sentences.zh: 重新构思这些套话的麻烦。

sentences.en: But the bulk of it was new.
sentences.zh: 但大部分内容是崭新的。

sentences.en: And while we don't know exactly how Peggy responded
sentences.zh: 虽然我们不知道佩吉对此作何具体反应，

sentences.en: to it, she clearly didn't tell him to knock it off.
sentences.zh: 但她显然没有叫他住手。

sentences.en: Her father, on the other hand, did.
sentences.zh: 另一方面，她的父亲却这么做了。

sentences.en: Publicly,
sentences.zh: 公开地，

sentences.en: Judge Shippen said the problem was Arnold's damaged leg, which he worried would never heal and might
sentences.zh: 希彭法官表示问题在于阿诺德受伤的腿，他担心这永远不会痊愈，并可能

sentences.en: therefore limit his ability to earn a living.
sentences.zh: 因此限制他谋生的能力。

sentences.en: Privately, he saw Arnold as a nouveau riche usurper.
sentences.zh: 私下里，他把阿诺德看作一个暴发户篡权者。

sentences.en: And politically, Arnold was far too incendiary.
sentences.zh: 而在政治上，阿诺德则具有极大的煽动性。

sentences.en: Biographer Randall writes that when Peggy's father
sentences.zh: 传记作家兰德尔写道，当佩吉的父亲

sentences.en: refused Arnold's request to marry her, she proceeded to orchestrate a bit of a coup.
sentences.zh: 拒绝了阿诺德的求婚请求时，她转而策划了一场小型政变。

sentences.en: She convinced her father she was unsure about Arnold, but told Arnold to keep coming around.
sentences.zh: 她让父亲相信她对阿诺德并不确定，但同时又告诉阿诺德继续来往。

sentences.en: She likely coached him about how to get on her father's good side.
sentences.zh: 她很可能指导了阿诺德如何赢得她父亲的好感。

sentences.en: When Arnold bought a lavish estate
sentences.zh: 当阿诺德买下一座豪华庄园

sentences.en: intended as a wedding gift for Peggy, Judge Shippen was likely reassured that his daughter would not
sentences.zh: 作为送给佩吉的结婚礼物时，希彭法官很可能打消了顾虑，确信女儿不会

sentences.en: be gambling on a future with a maimed, divisive military figure in decline.
sentences.zh: 把未来押在一个残疾、饱受争议且走下坡路的军事人物身上。

sentences.en: But Peggy reportedly
sentences.zh: 但据报道，佩吉

sentences.en: still had to throw one or two of her famous fits to get her father to finally give in.
sentences.zh: 还是大闹了一两次她那著名的脾气，才终于让父亲妥协。

sentences.en: Arnold and Peggy were engaged.
sentences.zh: 阿诺德和佩吉订婚了。

sentences.en: But outside the Shippen family circle, Arnold was more problematic than ever.
sentences.zh: 但在希彭家族的圈子之外，阿诺德比以往任何时候都更加麻烦不断。

sentences.en: Listen to the rest of the episode to hear Peggy's untold mark on history.
sentences.zh: 请收听本集的其余部分，了解佩吉在历史上留下的不为人知的印记。

sentences.en: And you might even hear
sentences.zh: 你甚至可能会听到

sentences.en: a special appearance from yours truly.
sentences.zh: 笔者本人的特别客串。

sentences.en: Head over to Significant Others to listen to the rest of the
sentences.zh: 现在就前往《另一半》收听

sentences.en: episode now.
sentences.zh: 本集的剩余内容吧。
